test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank and make the sentence meaningful.

Anuradha travelled to Italy last summer and ______________ the historic ruins of Rome.
solution:
The correct answer is '**explored**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**explored**" correctly fits the context of the sentence.
 
• "Explored" means to travel through (an unfamiliar area) in order to learn about it.
 
• The other options: "ascplored," "explord," and "explaured" are misspelled and do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Anuradha travelled to Italy last summer and explored__ the historic ruins of Rome.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Explored (अन्वेषण किया)**: means to travel in or through a place to learn about or familiarize oneself with it.
 
• **Traveller (यात्री)**: someone who takes a trip or journey.
 
• **Ancient Ruins (प्राचीन खंडहर)**: remains of structures built in ancient times.

36:Tbe0,

The correct answer is: Option 3
